drhp.business: ICICI Bank offers a comprehensive range of banking and financial services to retail, corporate, and institutional clients, including lending, deposit-taking, wealth management, insurance, and asset management. It operates through an extensive branch and digital network, serving customers across India and select international markets. The Bank's subsidiaries and associates span life and general insurance, asset management, and venture funds, enabling a unified 'One Bank, One Team' approach.
drhp.end_markets: India (domestic retail, corporate, SME)|Overseas markets (NRI banking, international corporate)
drhp.expansion: The Bank does not describe specific plant, smelter, or mine capex projects. Its expansion narrative is focused on strategic investments in technology and cybersecurity to strengthen operational infrastructure, ensuring scalability and robustness, and on deepening presence across ecosystems and micro markets in a unified manner. The Bank continues to make investments in technology and cybersecurity as part of its ongoing operational resilience and delivery system enhancements.

risks.note: Heightened uncertainty for the global economy, potential supply-chain disruptions, and upward pressure on energy and commodity prices, which could fuel inflation and force tighter monetary policy.
RBI projects CPI at 4.6% for FY2027; upside pressure from energy and below-normal monsoon could erode household savings and loan repayment capacity.

risks.note: Rupee depreciated ~10.9% in FY2026; 10-year G-sec yield rose to 7.04%. Sustained depreciation and higher yields can increase the cost of foreign-currency borrowings and mark-to-market hits on the investment portfolio.
risks.risk: Rupee depreciation and rising bond yields

risks.note: As a systemically important bank, failure in technology, cybersecurity, or delivery systems could disrupt operations, erode customer trust, and attract regulatory sanction.
While the Bank focuses on granular loan growth, rapid expansion in personal credit (system grew 6.2% YoY) without adequate risk-pricing could lead to higher slippages in a downturn.
risks.risk: Concentration in unsecured retail or granular credit segments
